2608.27856.title: FedEHR-Agents: Federated Agentic Optimization for Automated EHR Modeling
2608.27856.paper_summary: Recent advances in large language models are enabling autonomous clinical agents to perform increasingly complex electronic health record (EHR) modeling workflows. However, agents deployed at individual hospitals remain constrained by institution-specific data and modeling environments, while direct cross-hospital collaboration is restricted by the sensitivity of patient-level EHR data. Although federated learning (FL) provides a natural foundation for privacy-preserving collaboration, existing approaches remain predominantly model-centric, limiting federation to prediction models or their updates while overlooking the richer modeling experience accumulated by autonomous agents. To address this limitation, we propose FedEHR-Agents, an experience-centric federated agentic optimization framework for automated EHR modeling. Each hospital deploys an autonomous clinical EHR agent that performs data preprocessing and model development while refining local clinical modeling experience through historical memory, task-specific evaluation, and TextGrad-based prompt refinement. The federated server performs evidence-guided experience aggregation to integrate reliable and complementary modeling experience across heterogeneous hospitals and distills the aggregated experience into global meta-prompts for subsequent local refinement. Extensive experiments on real-world multi-hospital EHR benchmarks demonstrate that FedEHR-Agents consistently outperforms local and federated baselines across diverse clinical prediction tasks and remains robust across different federation scales and LLM backbones. These results establish clinical modeling experience as a promising collaborative object beyond conventional parameter-centric FL and point toward federated autonomous clinical intelligence.
2608.27856.paper_summary_zh: 最近在大型語言模型方面的進展使得自主臨床代理能夠執行越來越複雜的電子健康紀錄 (EHR) 建模工作流程。<lb/>然而，部署在個別醫院的代理仍然受到機構特定數據和建模環境的限制，而直接的跨醫院合作則受到患者級 EHR 數據敏感性的限制。<lb/>儘管聯邦學習 (FL) 為保護隱私的合作提供了自然的基礎，但現有的方法仍然主要以模型為中心，將聯邦限制在預測模型或其更新上，而忽略了自主代理所積累的更豐富的建模經驗。<lb/>為了解決這一限制，我們提出了 FedEHR-Agents，一個以經驗為中心的聯邦代理優化框架，用於自動化 EHR 建模。<lb/>每個醫院部署一個自主臨床 EHR 代理，該代理執行數據預處理和模型開發，同時通過歷史記憶、任務特定評估和基於 TextGrad 的提示優化來完善本地臨床建模經驗。<lb/>聯邦伺服器執行基於證據的經驗聚合，以整合來自異質醫院的可靠和互補的建模經驗，並將聚合的經驗提煉成全球元提示，以便後續的本地優化。<lb/>在真實世界的多醫院 EHR 基準上進行的大量實驗表明，FedEHR-Agents 在各種臨床預測任務中始終優於本地和聯邦基準，並在不同的聯邦規模和 LLM 骨幹中保持穩健。<lb/>這些結果確立了臨床建模經驗作為一個超越傳統參數中心 FL 的有前景的合作對象，並指向聯邦自主臨床智能的方向。
